name: Mumble (plugins)
description: The reviewed Mumble evidence concerns its plugin update channel. It does not establish the complete plugin authentication policy or verify the separate primary-application updater claim.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release-specific behavior and external TLS/framework enforcement were not independently audited.
No conclusion is made about Qt’s TLS implementation or the separate main-app updater/AuthentiCode path.
